hints: Find the centre as the midpoint of $P(1, 1)$ and $Q(7, 11)$.
Write the equation $(x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2$.
walkthrough:
Calculate the coordinates of the circle centre $C$ as the midpoint of diameter $PQ$:
$$C = \left(\frac{1 + 7}{2}, \frac{1 + 11}{2}\right) = (4, 6)$$

Calculate the square of the radius $r^2$ from centre $(4, 6)$ to point $P(1, 1)$:
$$r^2 = (4 - 1)^2 + (6 - 1)^2 = 3^2 + 5^2 = 9 + 25 = 34$$

Write the standard equation of the circle:
$$(x - 4)^2 + (y - 6)^2 = 34\quad\left(\text{or } x^2 + y^2 - 8x - 12y + 18 = 0\right)$$

ai_rubric.Circle Equation from Diameter: Finds centre $(4, 6)$ (B1), calculates $r^2 = 34$ (B1), sets up standard form (M1), and gives $(x-4)^2 + (y-6)^2 = 34$ (A1).

walkthrough:
Calculate the gradient of the radius $CQ$ from centre $(4, 6)$ to point $Q(7, 11)$:
$$m_{\text{rad}} = \frac{11 - 6}{7 - 4} = \frac{5}{3}$$

Determine the perpendicular gradient of the tangent line at $Q$:
$$m_{\text{tan}} = -\frac{1}{m_{\text{rad}}} = -\frac{3}{5}$$

Write the equation of the tangent line through $Q(7, 11)$:
$$y - 11 = -\frac{3}{5}(x - 7) \implies 5(y - 11) = -3(x - 7) \implies 3x + 5y = 76\quad\left(\text{or } y = -\frac{3}{5}x + \frac{76}{5}\right)$$

ai_rubric.Tangent Line Equation: Finds radius slope $\frac{5}{3}$ (B1), normal/tangent gradient $-\frac{3}{5}$ (M1), and writes $3x + 5y = 76$ (or $y = -\frac{3}{5}x + \frac{76}{5}$) (A1).

hints: Substitute $x = 7$ into the circle equation to find $R(7, 1)$.
walkthrough:
Find the coordinates of $R$ by substituting $x = 7$ into the circle equation $(x - 4)^2 + (y - 6)^2 = 34$:
$$(7 - 4)^2 + (y - 6)^2 = 34 \implies 9 + (y - 6)^2 = 34 \implies (y - 6)^2 = 25 \implies y = 6 - 5 = 1 \implies R(7, 1)$$

Find the equation of the tangent at $R(7, 1)$ with gradient $m = \frac{3}{5}$ (by reflection symmetry of radius slope $-\frac{5}{3}$):
$$y - 1 = \frac{3}{5}(x - 7) \implies 3x - 5y = 16$$

Solve the two tangent equations simultaneously:
$$3x + 5y = 76$$
$$3x - 5y = 16$$

Add and subtract the equations to find the intersection coordinates:
$$6x = 92 \implies x = \frac{46}{3}$$
$$10y = 60 \implies y = 6$$
$$\text{Intersection point: } \left(\frac{46}{3}, 6\right)$$

ai_rubric.Intersection of Tangents: Finds $R(7, 1)$ (B1), writes tangent at $R$ as $3x - 5y = 16$ (B1), solves simultaneous equations (M1), and obtains $\left(\frac{46}{3}, 6\right)$ (A1).
